title: AE2 Buddycards
description: Collect new Applied Energistics 2 themed Singularity Set Buddycards!
body:
![Buddycards logo](https://imgur.com/oPyioud.png)
**A new collection of Applied Energistics 2 Buddycards has arrived!**

The Singularity Set is a new collection of 18 Buddycards themed around the Applied Energistics mod. The new set uses a complex recipe that makes it more suited for the late game, with each pack needing Collection Processors, Paint Balls, and Sky Stone Card Blanks. These recipes will need a new Inscriber Press, processing new Luminis Dust, as well as also using Buddysteel. Automating the production of these packs using AE2 technology should be a fun challenge for players in the mid to late-game, and it balances out well with other expansions that might be easier to find in the earlier game. Like other sets, the Singularity set comes with Medals and Binders, and there is also a new Sky Stone variant for the Card Stand.
